findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "describe_node_type" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Everything about one node type: its help page (purpose, typical uses, inputs and outputs, settings, tips and pitfalls, nodes it works well with), its pins, its …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
